subject: Black Pudding
picture: A black pudding hangs from a dungeon ceiling and drips toward the floor. It is a heavy dripping blob with a few large bubble shapes, not a cube and not a flat floor puddle only. Stone ceiling, block walls, large floor slabs, closed wooden door. Bold even black outlines on white, same look as locked I-01 and I-02. The pudding itself is outlines with white insides to color, not a solid black fill.
